description: Winding, insulation, insertion, fusing, balancing and testing equipment for brushed, brushless and universal motors — supplied as individual machines or complete turnkey production lines. Built in Taichung, Taiwan since 1992.

heroImage._source: The old home page banner at 1920x680, blurred and darkened at build time to serve as a full-bleed backdrop. Baking the blur beats a CSS filter: no repaint on scroll, and the file drops to 16 KB. It also hides the weaknesses in the source photography, which is exactly why this treatment works where a sharp full-bleed image would not.

cta.title: Send us the part. We will tell you the line.
cta.lede: Tell us the stator, armature or rotor you need to produce and the output you are planning for, and we will come back with a machine selection or a full line layout. We have planned plants from zero for fifty listed manufacturers worldwide; the conversation starts with your part, not our catalogue.
cta.note: We reply within one business day. Specifications are never gated — only the full PDF catalogue asks for an email.

_langNote: Only languages that actually have pages may appear in the switcher. Listing 日本語 before the Japanese pages exist would repeat the 404 problem that shipped on 2026-07-29. Planned order: Japanese first (Nittoku's home market), then German (Elmotec, GROB, Aumann territory), then Spanish (Mexico, and the PLASTIMAGEN customer base). Translation must be done properly — machine translation of slot liner, knurling or fusing will be wrong, and wrong technical vocabulary is worse than no page.
